Department for General Assembly and Conference Management, Protocol and Liaison Service -- Protocol announcement – BriefingA joint in-person briefing for delegations regarding the general debate and high-level meetings of the eighty-first session of the General Assembly by the Department for General Assembly and Conference Management, the Department of Safety and Security, the Division of Administration of the Department of Operational Support, the Office of Information and Communications Technology, the Department of Global Communications, and the Executive Office of the Secretary-General will take place on Thursday, 13 August 2026 at 15:00 in Conference Room 4. Representatives of Permanent Missions and Observer Offices, as well as offices of specialized agencies and related organizations, are invited to participate in the briefing.
